title: CMaNGOS Classic-DB
baseline: WoW original client patch 1.12, community-maintained database snapshot; not Forever data
summaryMethod: Original text generated from structured target names and counts, NPC relation names and quest flags; no quest dialogue or objective prose copied.
coverage: All database quests categorized to 18 atlas zones, their starting subzones and attached dungeon categories; level 10–16 druid class chains added to Moonglade. Not a claim of every Classic quest that physically takes place in these zones.
notes: minLevel and questLevel are database values; maxLevel is a suggested upper planning level, not an eligibility maximum.
Item requiredLevel 0 means no explicit item requirement; quest eligibility still applies.
Reward choice arrays represent alternatives; they are not all granted together.
Quest summaries are generated research text and should be editorially refined for route anchors.
Individual Wowhead URLs are cross-reference links; values were extracted from the pinned CMaNGOS snapshot.

Curated route-anchor summaries were editorially rewritten from structured objectives; underlying DB quest objective text was consulted for event-only tasks. Class and reputation eligibility fields are retained.

databaseMaxLevel retains the source value. requiredMaxLevel is null when the database uses its 255 default (or 0); otherwise it is a real eligibility ceiling. Four care-package quests have explicit ceilings of 34 or 44.
maxLevel is a suggested upper planning level capped at 60 and any explicit eligibility ceiling. recommendedBand separates planning levels from quest eligibility.
Five entries are flagged Historical: three unsupported no-start variants and two legacy mount exchanges. Do not feature these as route recommendations.
Four AQ war-effort event records retain their specific eventRestrictions. AQ instance quest categories are typed Raid.
Only literal development Welcome! and placeholder Onu is meditating entries were excluded. Seasonal quests sorted into negative holiday categories are outside this zone-category import.
Item source relations distinguish required objectives, supplied tools, starter items, guaranteed quest rewards and reward choices; objective association does not itself identify a drop creature.
expandedCoverage: Original-world items requiring level 60 or below, retained editorial entries, quests across both continents and special categories, and spawned or quest-linked NPCs. Development placeholders are excluded. Recipe entries are recipe items, not a complete learned-spell database. NPC and object loot links include direct loot rows only. Additional categories cover interactive world objects and selected trained, starting, recipe-linked and item-creation spells. Every record supports its own public discussion.
